purpose: Evaluate one already frozen numerical-compensation point by standalone and real merged accuracy; do not tune or reopen its failed strict retention result.
registration_context: Post-hoc follow-up after observing complete standalone accuracy; not a blind preregistered candidate or a pass under the old R0.5 gate.
policy: Use existing native counts and matched clean controls. Pilot then full using existing evaluator. Report target and partner, per-class and paired outcomes; no new pass threshold. Do not alter point,source,rank,class,bound or amplitude after partner results. No new optimizer or expert training.
utility_reference: MergeGuard CVPR2026 section6 reports top-1 standalone accuracy before/after; this supports separate reporting, not retrospective success under our previous stricter protocol.
